title: Independent verification: bind all 511 cold hyperplane operators with phase and spectator
body:
## Result and scope

Independent finite semantic binding for **empty entrance E=0 and all 511
hyperplane terminals U in F2^9**: the actual canonical-frame circuit and
serialized child wrappers satisfy `L^-1 T_U R^-1 = C_[8] tensor I_2`, exactly
including global phase and the wrapped coordinate chart's one spectator.

The retained HPE proof note records a local all-511 cold check but says its
checking script was not shipped. This package makes that source-side premise
reproducible; the original finding retains credit. **No new Lean theorem,
kernel execution, emitted-word replay, supplier adoption, invoice or kappa.**

## Assignment, source binding and overlap

- Track/card: independent-verification / `formal-interface-lemma`, refined to
  the independent theorem-to-certificate binding method.
- OS nonce `3b261ab51d51856a178fbaca68514f8a`; catalogue scope key
  `e3ffea67887eeb4c396c`.
- Base `d78fe4bbb6f6b769e39586f8bb3ba8c31a31fd3a`.
- Exact object: generic `exact_cold` / `cold_hyperplane_width` in
  `HyperplaneEnd/Multi.lean`, zero entrance, normals 1..511, source
  `canonical_frame(9,U)` and serialized `lower_child` monomials.
- Base-commit Git blobs and SHA256 pins are in SOURCES.json. Formal source
  last-change commit `1db1fbe68cb5186899cf1fd691bc92056a845e49`; compiler
  last-change commit `e07a8a3f9f79c22113398a0c5dbbc7601f489b3e`.
- Entry survey and immediate concrete-term overlap refresh preceded
  computation. Final refresh at 2026-10-14T07:13Z covered 385 open PRs and
  337 discussions with complete pagination, plus local notes/ledger.
- https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1415 is the three
  non-cold C7/two-spectator pairs. Existing cold14 packages check fourteen
  rank-four endpoints. Neither supplies this all-511 rank-eight audit.
  No competing concrete binding was found; no novelty certificate claimed.
- Claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-18917564.

## Evidence and independent method

Every annihilator kernel has 256 elements and an independently constructed
eight-vector basis. Every producer child reports rank eight and the zero
entrance has an empty circuit. Candidate constructors internally use their
tableau/zero-state machinery; neither is the independent acceptance oracle.

A separately written Gaussian-integer literal evaluator and serialized inverse
monomial evaluator compare the wrapped operation against the closed-form C8
kernel `16*(-i)^popcount(delta)` at common denominator256, with cross-spectator
zeros. The encoded input uses radix2^18. A proved numerator coefficient bound
4^8 plus reference bound16 gives difference digits <=65552 < radix-1, so exact
packed equality forces all matrix entries to agree. This logically covers
261632 complex-linear columns / 133955584 entries without storing those matrices.
It is not a claim that equality on an arbitrary single input proves equality.

Five circuit faults reject, plus the unsafe-radix alias control. Optimized CLI
tests reject omitted-hyperplane/unsafe-radix receipts and int/float or int/Boolean
receipt aliases with explicit diagnostics. The type-alias edge case was found
in separate AI review, reproduced by failing tests and fixed by type-preserving
canonical JSON comparison. Fresh registered replay passed afterward.

The separate read-only AI mathematical/code reviews found no critical or
important issue. The code reviewer independently expanded ordinary basis
columns 0,1,255,256,511 at normals 1,257,511 using Gaussian/Fraction arithmetic:
30 physical/wrapped equations and 15360 row entries agreed, including global
phase and spectator identity. That review is not human or kernel review.

## Files and reproduction

Adds only `research/cold-hyperplane-semantic-binding/`:
`README.md`, `TASK.json`, `SOURCES.json`, `VERIFY.json`, `RESULT.json`,
`verify.py`, `test_verify.py`. Predecessor sources and selected record untouched.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/cold-hyperplane-semantic-binding --check-only
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/cold-hyperplane-semantic-binding
```

Observed on Windows/Python3.12: metadata/pins PASS; two unittest groups PASS
(79.309s); full registered replay PASS.

```text
PASS_COLD_HYPERPLANE_SEMANTIC_BINDING hyperplanes=511 columns=261632 entries=133955584 controls=5 global_phase spectator_preserved no_new_kappa
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/cold-hyperplane-semantic-binding outcome=completed
```

## Remaining obligations and credit

This supplies external finite evidence for hE/hU in the stated operator model,
not a numeric-mask-to-Lean adapter or a proof term. Actual helper unit rows/
zero columns, tails, recipes, chronology, footprints, whole-call hosting,
precision/tape, all-size compiler and analytic obligations are not rechecked.
No new moment or a<D/E improvement is claimed: the conditional width-eight
operator interface is checked, not a new fully priced physical supplier.
The bounded next question in README/TASK is a formal normal-1 cold instance
followed by a generic canonical-frame semantic bridge. No full cold replay or
hosted-CI success is claimed.

(https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1415), icekylinx's retained
compiler package and the original cold14 source checks. No predecessor files
are copied or edited. Prepared by **Aaron Wang / navinor, with help from
chatgpt**, including substantial research, implementation, writing and separate
read-only AI reviews. Apache-2.0.

Workflow feedback: the formal-pair survey prevented repeating a saturated
non-cold audit. The smallest/mixed probes succeeded before the complete family.
No directly fitting open handoff was found; the chosen card's source-binding
route was retained. No dependencies were installed. At the donor's request,
the temporary custom-location worktree will be cleaned after publication.
